seoTitle: Import Etsy & Temu Reviews to Shopify with Kudosi
metaDescription: Bring Etsy and Temu product reviews into your Shopify store with the Kudosi app and its browser extension. Note: Etsy and Temu imports need a paid Kudosi plan.
intro: Real customer feedback from Etsy and Temu can make a new Shopify store look far more credible than empty product pages. Kudosi (formerly Ali Reviews) does this with a Shopify app plus a browser extension that scans reviews straight off a live marketplace listing. The one thing worth knowing before you start: Kudosi's free plan only imports from AliExpress. Pulling reviews from Etsy, Temu, Amazon, or eBay specifically needs a paid plan, which this guide covers alongside the actual scan-and-import workflow.
costNote: Kudosi's Free plan lets you publish up to 10 reviews per product and import unlimited reviews from AliExpress, but it does not unlock Etsy or Temu as import sources. That needs the Basic plan, $14.95/month (or $134.40/year), which also raises the published-review cap to 150 per product and adds Amazon and eBay as sources. Basic comes with a 14-day free trial, so you can run the Etsy or Temu import without paying immediately, but it isn't a permanently free feature.

steps.heading: Install Kudosi and check which plan you're on
steps.body: From your Shopify admin, install Kudosi (formerly Ali Reviews) from the App Store. It adds its own section to the left-hand menu, with Import Reviews, Collect Reviews, Manage Reviews, and display settings. Before scanning anything, check your plan under Kudosi's billing settings. If you're on Free, Etsy and Temu will show as available source tiles in the Import Reviews screen, but scanning from them will prompt an upgrade; that's expected, not a bug.

image.caption: Kudosi's Import Reviews screen inside the Shopify admin, with source tiles for Amazon, AliExpress, eBay, Temu, Dsers, and Etsy.

steps.heading: Add the Kudosi browser extension
steps.body: Importing straight from a live Etsy or Temu listing needs a companion browser extension, not just the Shopify app itself. Search the Chrome Web Store for Kudosi (formerly Ali Reviews) and add it to Chrome. At the time of writing it carries a rating in the low 4s across tens of thousands of users, worth a glance since extensions with review-scraping permissions are exactly the kind of tool you want a track record on before installing. Once added, its icon appears in your browser toolbar on any product page you visit afterward.

image.caption: The Kudosi (formerly Ali Reviews) listing in the Chrome Web Store, showing its rating and user count before installing.

steps.heading: Scan reviews from an Etsy or Temu product page
steps.body: Open the actual Etsy or Temu product whose reviews you want, then click the Kudosi extension icon in the toolbar. A side panel slides in asking you to pick your Shopify store and the specific product you're importing into. Below that, optional filters let you require reviews to have photos or written text before they're pulled in. Click Scan Reviews and the extension reads the review data off the page you're on. According to Kudosi's own help documentation, one scan can pull in up to 1,000 reviews and up to 5 images per review, so trim the list down to what fits your product before importing.

image.caption: The Kudosi extension panel open on an Etsy product page, with store and product selectors above the Scan reviews button.

steps.heading: Repeat on a matching listing, then curate before publishing
steps.body: The workflow for Temu is identical in structure: find the Temu product that matches what you're selling, open the same extension panel, select the destination product, and scan. Getting the source listing close to your own product matters more than the marketplace it came from, since an imported review should describe the item you're selling. Back in the Shopify admin under Manage Reviews, scanned reviews sit in a queue instead of going live automatically. Use the bulk actions there to approve or reject many at once, and remove anything that references a color, size, or feature you don't stock.

steps.heading: Set how reviews display on your storefront
steps.body: Once reviews are approved, the Show Reviews section controls the widget rendered on your product pages: star ratings, review count, layout, and whether photos are included. Match this to your theme instead of leaving Kudosi's defaults in place, since a review block that looks bolted on undercuts the trust it's supposed to build. Check a live product page on both desktop and mobile after adjusting the settings.

troubleshooting.problem: Scan Reviews is greyed out or prompts an upgrade on an Etsy or Temu page
troubleshooting.cause: Your Kudosi plan is Free, which only imports from AliExpress.
troubleshooting.fix: Upgrade to at least the Basic plan, or use its 14-day free trial, to unlock Etsy and Temu as import sources.

troubleshooting.problem: The extension finds no reviews to scan
troubleshooting.cause: You're not on the product's actual review section, or the listing has too few reviews for the extension to detect.
troubleshooting.fix: Scroll to the reviews section on the source page so it's fully loaded, then reopen the extension panel and scan again.

troubleshooting.problem: Imported reviews look out of place on the storefront
troubleshooting.cause: A review references a variant, color, or size your Shopify product doesn't carry, or it just reads as generic filler.
troubleshooting.fix: Remove it in Manage Reviews before publishing; only approve reviews that plausibly describe your actual listing.

faq.question: Is importing Etsy and Temu reviews really free?
faq.answer: No. Kudosi's Free plan only imports from AliExpress. Etsy and Temu require the Basic plan ($14.95/month), which does come with a 14-day free trial.

faq.question: Will this work for a dropshipping store?
faq.answer: Yes, it's built with dropshippers in mind, though any store can use it to add social proof from a matching listing.

faq.question: Can I import reviews for many products at once?
faq.answer: Manage Reviews inside Kudosi supports bulk actions, so approving or rejecting scanned reviews doesn't have to happen one product at a time.

faq.question: Is there a limit on how many reviews I can scan in one go?
faq.answer: Kudosi's documentation lists a cap of up to 1,000 reviews and 5 images per review per scan.

faq.question: Do I need the browser extension, or does the Shopify app alone work?
faq.answer: You need both. The Shopify app manages your review library, plan, and display settings, while the Chrome extension is what scans reviews off a live Etsy or Temu product page.
